symptom: Kernel ran on CPU — no GPU allocated (log: 'platform CPU'; quota 0.00 GPU-h)
fix: Set "enable_gpu": true in kernel-metadata.json; verify 'platform CUDA' in the first log lines; preflight G21 checks it statically
root_cause: kernel-metadata.json omitted enable_gpu; kaggle CLI defaults it to false

symptom: Silent CPU fallback burned ~7 h wall before cancellation (~100x slowdown: B1 22531 s vs ~3.5 min)
fix: Fail fast on CPU when not in MBZ_DRY mode; log steps/s vs the ~240 steps/s P100 baseline at every 50 ps checkpoint
root_cause: platform try/except continued on CPU with a single log line instead of aborting

symptom: Cancelled kernel left the Kaggle usage ledger showing the project busy days later
fix: Always run tools/kaggle_usage.py end --status failed on cancel, with gpu_minutes from kaggle quota
root_cause: No END entry written on cancellation

symptom: Research-model hallucinations in calibration data: wrong DOI (S87313 vs real 10.2147/DDDT.S84052), 50 ns claim misattributed to orlistat (belongs to the lead), unverified Rg range
fix: Verify every literature numeric against the primary-source full text before it enters registry/calibration.json; record corrections in the verification note
root_cause: Literature numbers entered the registry from model recall without primary-source verification
